name: whoami
description: Show the current AWS identity, account and region.
body: Show the active AWS identity using the `cloud-aws` skill. Detect the aws CLI first. Run `aws sts get-caller-identity` and `aws configure list` (redacting any secret). Report the account, ARN and default region. Read-only.

name: s3
description: List/inspect S3 buckets and flag public exposure (read-only).
body: Inspect S3 for $ARGUMENTS using the `cloud-aws`/`security-cloud` skills. List buckets (or a bucket's objects), and check public-access-block and bucket policy for any public exposure. Report findings; never upload, delete or make anything public.

name: ec2
description: List EC2 instances with state, type and cost signals.
body: List EC2 instances for $ARGUMENTS using the `cloud-aws` skill. Run `aws ec2 describe-instances` and summarize id, state, type, and anything idle/oversized worth cost review. Read-only; never start/stop/terminate instances.

name: logs
description: Tail and analyze a CloudWatch log group.
body: Analyze the CloudWatch log group in $ARGUMENTS using the `log-analysis` skill. Fetch recent events (`aws logs tail`), surface errors and their likely cause, and redact any secrets that appear. Read-only.

name: iam-audit
body: Audit IAM for $ARGUMENTS using the `security-iam` skill. List attached policies and flag wildcard (*) actions/resources, long-lived access keys and unused privileges. Recommend least-privilege changes. Read-only; do not modify policies.

name: cost
description: Summarize AWS cost drivers and savings (read-only).
body: Summarize AWS spend using the `cloud-cost-optimization` skill (Cost Explorer / resource inventory where available). Identify idle/oversized resources and unused storage, and suggest safe savings ranked by impact. Read-only.

name: whoami
description: Show the current Azure account and subscription.
body: Show the active Azure context using the `cloud-azure` skill. Detect the az CLI, run `az account show`, and report subscription and tenant (redacting ids as needed). Read-only.

name: resources
description: List Azure resource groups and key resources (read-only).
body: List Azure resources for $ARGUMENTS using the `cloud-azure` skill. Summarize resource groups and notable resources, flagging untagged sprawl and public exposure. Read-only; never create/modify/delete.

name: aks
description: Show AKS cluster status and node health.
body: Report AKS status for $ARGUMENTS using the `cloud-managed-kubernetes` skill. Show clusters, node pools and health via az/kubectl. Read-only.

name: whoami
description: Show the active gcloud account and project.
body: Show the active GCP context using the `cloud-gcp` skill. Detect gcloud, run `gcloud auth list` and `gcloud config list`, and report account/project. Read-only.

name: resources
description: List key GCP resources for the current project (read-only).
body: List GCP resources for $ARGUMENTS using the `cloud-gcp`/`security-cloud` skills. Summarize compute/storage and flag public buckets and broad IAM roles. Read-only; never create/modify/delete.

name: gke
description: Show GKE cluster status and node health.
body: Report GKE status for $ARGUMENTS using the `cloud-managed-kubernetes` skill via gcloud/kubectl. Show clusters, node pools and health. Read-only.

name: pods
description: List pods and highlight unhealthy ones.
body: List Kubernetes pods for $ARGUMENTS using the `kubernetes-core` skill. Detect kubectl. Show status across namespaces and highlight CrashLoopBackOff/Pending/OOMKilled. Read-only.

name: logs
description: Fetch and analyze logs for a pod (including previous crash).
body: Fetch logs for the pod in $ARGUMENTS using `kubectl logs` (and `--previous` on crashes), then analyze with the `log-analysis` skill. Surface errors and likely cause; redact secrets. Read-only.

name: describe
description: Describe a resource and explain its events/state.
body: Describe the Kubernetes resource in $ARGUMENTS using the `kubernetes-troubleshooting` skill. Run `kubectl describe`, read events, and explain the state and any scheduling/probe/image issues. Read-only.

name: top
description: Show pod/node resource usage to find hotspots.
body: Show Kubernetes resource usage for $ARGUMENTS using the `kubernetes-core` skill (`kubectl top`). Identify pods/nodes near their limits and note missing requests/limits. Read-only.

name: rollout
description: Check a deployment's rollout status and history.
body: Check the rollout of the deployment in $ARGUMENTS using the `deployment-strategies` skill (`kubectl rollout status/history`). Report progress and, if stuck, the likely cause. Suggest (do not auto-run) an undo if the new revision is failing.

name: plan
description: Run terraform plan and review the change for safety.
body: Run and review `terraform plan` for $ARGUMENTS using the `iac-terraform` skill. Detect terraform/tofu, init if needed, and summarize what will be created/changed/destroyed. Flag any replace/destroy of stateful resources. Never run apply automatically.

name: validate
body: Validate Terraform for $ARGUMENTS using the `iac-terraform` skill: run `terraform fmt -check` and `terraform validate`, and report syntax/formatting issues and any obvious misconfigurations. Read-only.
